The production fix uses the installed public SDK suppressHostOutput primitive for status,stop,and doctor through one tested shared output owner; packed npx and bunx now each return exactly one parseable document.

The package catalog mirrors every fleet manifest including pm-rl. A fresh packed acceptance defect exposed duplicate JSON from web status; web status, stop, and doctor now use the public suppressHostOutput primitive through one tested output owner. The real PostgreSQL coverage gate passes 289 tests at 66.18 percent lines, 80.40 percent branches, and 60.45 percent functions across all 26 configured sources; thresholds ratchet to 66/80/60.
